title: Entity Personal Status V2.5
description: The Personal Status of an Entity, assembled by Personal Status Multiplexing from the per-modality Personal Statuses (Text, Speech, Face, Body). It combines the modality Personal Statuses that are present; each is optional and at least one is expected.

EntityPersonalStatusTime.description: Time this Entity Personal Status was produced.

TextPersonalStatus.description: Personal Status of the Text modality (optional).

SpeechPersonalStatus.description: Personal Status of the Speech modality (optional).

FacePersonalStatus.description: Personal Status of the Face modality (optional).

GesturePersonalStatus.description: Personal Status of the Gesture modality (optional).
